instruction: Navigate to the orange steel jacket support tower whose HIGHEST structural level is a horizontal rectangular platform with safety railings. It has four lattice legs. A pointed or triangular lattice rising above a lower deck does not match this target. Approach the flat-top structure from traversable land and stop outside it.
note: Only a target appearance instruction is supplied. Online geometry is built from robot RGB-D. Execution switching uses measured contact and buoyancy; the navigation planner receives no river mesh or target Stage coordinates.
